title: Average strength reduction.
officialText: As data become available during construction, it is permissible to reduce the amount by which the average compressive strength (f ' ) is required to exceed the specified value of f' in accordance with ACI 318, Section c c 5.5. A new mix design shall be submitted to the registered design professional of record for approval prior to use.
